tokens.v: The customer is invoiced for an advance on a project contract line, the payment is received, and the advance waits to be settled against later invoices.

tokens.v: The customer's financial business partner group has a control account for advance invoices and payment requests and an account for advance receipts. A tax code for advance payments, used for sales with tax on payments. The mapping scheme maps the project revenue advance installment documents to those accounts.

before.text: The customer's financial business partner group has a control account for advance invoices and payment requests and an account for advance receipts. A tax code for advance payments, used for sales with tax on payments. The mapping scheme maps the project revenue advance installment documents to those accounts.

tokens.v: An advance payment request is an invoice for money not yet earned. It posts to an advance control account and an interim revenue account rather than to revenue, with tax on payment. When the customer pays, the advance moves to an advance-received account, where it waits until it is settled against the real invoices.
